runs.notes: file-level green = every executed test in the file passed and the file reported no out-of-test error; all-skipped / no-tests / blocked-external are separate buckets and are NOT passes. The corpus npm dependencies must be installed first (see compat/README.md) -- without them 264 files die at load; test/node_modules is excluded from discovery so third-party packages do not inflate the corpus

runs.runner: resumable incremental scan (xargs -P8 --timeout 15) on round-8 binary; pass count cross-validated against per-subsystem bounded runs
runs.notes: direct execution (mbun <file>, exit 0 = pass); node's own harness services (// Flags:, internal bindings) are not emulated, so files needing them count as failures — honest file-level coverage, not API completion. pass=1974 is a FRESH FULL MEASUREMENT on the round-8 binary (2026-07-21), cross-validated: the scan's per-subsystem pass counts match the isolated per-subsystem runs exactly (net 70, crypto 79, buffer 50, console 16). It corroborates and slightly exceeds the incremental derivation (round-4 1811 + r5 +24 + r6 +37 + r7 +40 + r8 +35 = 1947; measured 1974, +27 as fixed crashes let previously-timed-out files run). The raw -P8 scan's timeout bucket was contention-inflated to 1441; timeout is reported here as the isolated-runner ~620 (JS-layer work does not change what spawns/hangs), so fail = 4433 - pass - timeout - oom. harness_dependent = 351 files requiring node PRIVATE internals (--expose-internals / require('internal/*')); ~95% non-green and not a legitimate contract-compat target (bun/deno skip them too). Excluding them: 1961/4082 = 48.0% (contract-compat ceiling). Headline stays the strict 1974/4433 = 44.5%.
